name: sachikheti-platform
description: Full-Stack Agricultural E-Commerce Platform for SachiKheti (LFPC)

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install && node prisma/prepare.js && npx prisma generate
scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
